module_dispositions.rationale: Worked alignment narrative that motivates the executable procedures in §§769–812.
Alignrecord field aliases used by the lifecycle and packing properties.
Complete push/pop ownership of nested alignment delivery state.
Procedure-order overview; each named procedure is claimed below.
Alignment initialization, packing specification, mode transition, and display recovery.
Preamble list construction, delimiter identities, tabskip assignment, span expansion, and interwoven recovery.
Distinct u- and v-template scanning and malformed-parameter recovery.
Row lookahead selects noalign, finish, ignored crcr, or a new row.
Row semantic level, mode switch, and leading tabskip lifecycle.
Span semantic-level initialization in horizontal and vertical alignments.
Cell opening, u-template replay, delimiter interception, v-template replay, and omit-template selection.
End-v validation, cell/span completion, periodic extension, and extra-tab recovery.
Unset cell packaging, span maxima, and row packaging.
Preamble dismantling, span-width resolution, glue setting, rule dimensions, box conversion, and final mode-dependent append.
Missing-brace correction and misplaced alignment-command diagnostics.
Main-control alignment dispatch context for init_align and do_endv.
Effective end-v validation, active align-group completion, and off-save recovery.
Alignment-group right brace is backed up behind an inserted frozen cr.
Noalign group closure resumes alignment row lookahead.
Display alignment assignment scan, missing-double-math-shift diagnostic and backup recovery, list insertion, and display resumption.

properties.claim: Starting a nested alignment saves the complete outer preamble cursor, span and loop cursors, align_state, and adjustment list; finishing restores that exact state and frees only the inner level.
preconditions: An outer alignment delivery level is active with nondefault cursors and brace state.
stimulus: Existing unit `nested_alignment_resume_preserves_outer_align_state`; Phase 2 unit `nested_alignment_restores_all_delivery_fields` and semantic case `alignment-nested-state-stack`.
expected_observations: Begin, suspend, inner finish, and resume observations preserve structural nesting without exposing pointer identities.
postconditions: The outer cell, template ownership, brace depth, row/span cursors, and mode-facing adjustment list resume unchanged.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: one and two nested alignments; brace: balanced and nonzero outer depth; template: empty and nonempty outer templates; cell/row/span: first cell and active span; mode: halign and valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: abort an incomplete inner alignment and restore the outer level atomically without retiring its templates.

properties.claim: init_align pushes alignment state, installs the preamble sentinel, enters the opposite internal mode, scans the optional to/spread specification and opening brace, and rejects prior display material before preamble scanning.
preconditions: A legal halign/valign command is delivered in its admitted outer mode, optionally as the sole display material.
stimulus: Phase 2 units `alignment_scan_spec_consumes_brace_after_keyword_backups` and `alignment_initial_mode_matrix`; semantic cases `alignment-spec-modes` and `alignment-improper-display`.
expected_observations: Specification kind/value, align-group creation, preamble sentinel -1000000, and mode transition occur in TeX82 order.
postconditions: Preamble scanning owns a fresh alignment level and the enclosing prev_depth is preserved where TeX82 requires it.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: top-level and nested; brace: direct, to, and spread opener; template/cell/row/span: before all lifecycle activity; mode: vmode halign, hmode valign, display halign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: improper display material is flushed with the canonical diagnostic; missing specification brace uses compulsory-brace recovery.

properties.claim: Preamble scanning alternates copied tabskip glue with alignrecords, assigns distinct span/cr/crcr modifiers, expands only span-following tokens and tabskip specifications, and ends at a top-level cr.
preconditions: Alignment specification scanning has consumed its opening brace and align_state is -1000000.
expected_observations: Local/global tabskip updates and frozen delimiter identities are visible while ordinary preamble tokens remain unexpanded.
postconditions: The preamble has leading/intercolumn/trailing glue, frozen column pairs, periodic-loop identity if selected, and scanner status returns to normal.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: outer and inner preambles; brace: nested template braces; template: empty/nonempty pairs; cell/row/span: ordinary, span and crcr delimiters; mode: halign and valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: effective endv during preamble scanning raises interwoven-preamble failure; exhausted preamble input follows aligning-status EOF recovery.

properties.claim: The u-template drops leading spaces and ends at its first top-level parameter marker; the v-template retains tokens through its top-level delimiter, discards extra parameter markers with diagnostics, and appends frozen end-template.
preconditions: Preamble scanning is active at a new alignrecord.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `scan_u_v_templates_empty_nested_and_malformed` and semantic cases `alignment-template-scan` and `alignment-template-recovery`.
expected_observations: Frozen u/v token lists preserve braces and delimiter boundaries, with exactly one end-template appended to v.
postconditions: Every completed column has one u/v pair; empty u and v lists retain their canonical lifecycle distinctions.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: braces and nested macros inside templates; brace: balanced groups; template: empty u/v and token-rich u/v; cell/row/span: repeated columns and span expansion; mode: halign and valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing # backs up the top-level tab/cr for v scanning; extra # is discarded and v scanning continues; empty-u && selects periodic repetition only at the first eligible site.

properties.claim: align_peek resets align_state to 1000000, skips blanks and expandable calls, starts noalign after consuming its brace, finishes on right brace, ignores crcr, or backs up and starts a row and first cell.
preconditions: Preamble completion or fin_row has reached row lookahead.
expected_observations: Exactly one branch owns the lookahead token and u-template installation follows command-owned backup for an ordinary row.
postconditions: The engine is in noalign group, alignment finish, repeated lookahead, or a new row/cell with no duplicated token.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: outer and nested alignment; brace: closing and noalign opener; template: empty/nonempty u; cell/row/span: first row and later row; mode: internal vertical/horizontal.
recovery_cases: Recovery: malformed noalign opener uses scan_left_brace recovery; repeated crcr remains bounded and does not create an empty row.

properties.claim: init_row pushes one semantic level, switches halign to restricted horizontal mode or valign to internal vertical mode, appends the first tabskip, and begins a span at the first alignrecord.
preconditions: align_peek selected a real row and the preamble contains its leading glue and first alignrecord.
expected_observations: One leading tabskip precedes the first cell and the row-local auxiliary mode field is initialized canonically.
postconditions: cur_align and cur_span select the first column and the row list is ready for cell packaging.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: top-level/nested rows; brace: balanced row body; template: empty/nonempty first u; cell/row/span: first/later row and initial span; mode: halign/valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: an empty or exhausted preamble is rejected before row initialization rather than manufacturing a column.

properties.claim: init_span pushes a cell-list semantic level, initializes horizontal or vertical auxiliary state, normalizes paragraph state for valign, and records the starting alignrecord.
preconditions: A row has started or a completed nonspan cell advances to another span start.
expected_observations: The span start is the current column and subsequent span delimiters retain the same cell-list level.
postconditions: Cell material accumulates in a fresh list with canonical space_factor or prev_depth.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: nested alignment inside cell; brace: grouped cell material; template: omitted/ordinary; cell/row/span: one and multiple columns; mode: halign/valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: failed nested alignment rolls back its inner span level without changing the outer span start.

properties.claim: An ordinary cell backs up its first token and replays the selected u-template, whose exhaustion changes align_state from 1000000 to 0; a top-level delimiter then selects the saved v-template and restores 1000000, while omit bypasses u and selects only frozen end-template.
preconditions: A row/span is active, cur_align selects a frozen column, and lookahead has delivered omit or the cell's first token.
stimulus: Existing units `active_alignment_predicate_tracks_scanner_levels_not_only_cells` and `completed_alignment_cell_retires_exhausted_v_template_boundary`; Phase 2 unit `cell_template_delivery_matrix` and semantic case `alignment-cell-template-delivery`.
expected_observations: Backup correction precedes u-template push; delimiter identity is retained; u/v/omit pushes and retirements are distinct and ordered.
postconditions: The active v-template owns end-template/endv completion and no delimiter escapes as an ordinary command.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: nested box/alignment cell; brace: physical braces and control-sequence aliases; template: empty/nonempty u/v and omit; cell/row/span: tab/span/cr/crcr; mode: halign/valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: delimiter at align_state ±1 triggers missing-brace correction; delimiter during aligning or without cur_align reports interwoven-preamble failure.

properties.claim: A valid exhausted v-template permits fin_col to package the current cell, preserve spans across span delimiters, end a row on cr/crcr, or start the next cell; periodic preambles copy exact u/v lists and tabskip, while an extra tab without a loop is changed to cr.
preconditions: Effective endv was delivered from an exhausted active v-template and the align group remains active.
stimulus: Existing unit `do_endv_stack_walk_accepts_only_empty_frames_above_v_template`; Phase 2 units `fin_col_delimiter_matrix_and_periodic_extension` and `fin_col_extra_tab_recovers_to_cr`; semantic cases `alignment-finish-column` and `alignment-extra-tab`.
expected_observations: Saved delimiter, cell packaging, span continuation, row outcome, periodic-copy, and extra-tab recovery occur before template retirement.
postconditions: Exactly one next-cell, continued-span, or completed-row state results and align_state is 1000000 during lookahead.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: outer/inner endv; brace: balanced and corrected cell; template: ordinary/omit/periodic; cell/row/span: tab/span/cr/crcr and exhausted preamble; mode: halign/valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: invalid endv stack or align_state below 500000 raises interwoven-preamble failure; extra tab/span without periodic suffix becomes cr with the canonical diagnostic.

properties.claim: Cell completion naturally packs the current list into an unset node, records maximum single-column or ordered span width and glue orders, and row completion naturally packs all cells/tabskips into one unset row while moving halign adjustments outward.
preconditions: fin_col has a completed cell list and fin_row is invoked only after a row-ending delimiter.
expected_observations: Unset-node span_count, natural extent, stretch/shrink order, tabskip ordering, row dimensions, and adjustment placement match TeX82.
postconditions: The row list contains one unset row and the per-column/span maxima are ready for final width resolution.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: nested alignment cell boxes; brace: grouped material; template: ordinary/omit; cell/row/span: empty/nonempty and repeated span widths; mode: halign/valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: a span count beyond the representable TeX82 bound fails canonically; incomplete cell/row never publishes a partially packaged unset node.

properties.claim: fin_align removes the active alignment level, resolves unset column widths and sorted span constraints through intervening tabskip, packs the prototype to the saved specification, sets every row/cell and running rule dimension, then appends the completed list according to enclosing mode.
preconditions: align_peek delivered the alignment-closing right brace after all rows are represented as unset boxes.
expected_observations: Column null widths become zero, span constraints propagate monotonically, prototype glue ratios control every row, and running rules inherit final row dimensions.
postconditions: Preamble/template nodes are retired, the outer alignment state resumes, and the final h/v/display list contains only set boxes, glue, rules, and canonical surrounding material.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: nested finalization/resumption; brace: delivered closing brace; template: empty/omit/ordinary; cell/row/span: zero-width, multispan and multiple rows; mode: vmode, hmode and display.
recovery_cases: Recovery: overfull/underfull packing reports through normal pack diagnostics; malformed internal span ordering fails rather than producing a partial final list.

properties.claim: A tab/span/cr reaching main control at align_state -1 or 1 is backed up behind an inserted balancing brace; at larger absolute depth it is merely misplaced, and misplaced noalign or omit reports and is ignored.
preconditions: An alignment-sensitive command escaped normal zero-depth interception or appears outside its admitted lifecycle point.
stimulus: Existing unit `recovery_inserted_left_brace_updates_active_alignment_state`; Phase 2 unit `alignment_misplaced_command_recovery_matrix` and semantic case `alignment-delimiter-recovery`.
expected_observations: Backup correction, inserted brace delivery, restored zero depth, replayed delimiter interception, or misplaced-command discard is observed in canonical order.
postconditions: Recoverable ±1 cases resume the active cell; nonalignment cases do not create alignment state, templates, cells, rows, or spans.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: active and absent alignment; brace: -1/+1/>2; template: ordinary/omit; cell/row/span: tab/span/cr; mode: every main-control mode.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing left/right brace is inserted at ±1; otherwise tab/span/cr/noalign/omit produces its specific diagnostic and is ignored.

properties.claim: do_endv accepts only an effective endv above an exhausted v-template through empty token-list frames, finishes the cell/row only in align_group, and otherwise invokes off_save without losing the retained template.
preconditions: Frozen end-template has expanded to effective endv.
stimulus: Existing unit `do_endv_stack_walk_accepts_only_empty_frames_above_v_template`; Phase 2 unit `do_endv_validates_template_and_group_matrix` and semantic case `alignment-endv-off-save`.
expected_observations: Template provenance is validated before end_graf/fin_col, and off-save recovery precedes eventual template retirement.
postconditions: Success retires exactly the completed v-template and advances the cell/row; recovery retains it until replayed endv succeeds.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: nested template stacks; brace: balanced and wrong execution group; template: direct and empty-frame-separated endv; cell/row/span: cell/span/row endings; mode: hmode/vmode.
recovery_cases: Recovery: invalid template provenance is fatal interwoven-preamble failure; wrong group performs canonical off_save closer insertion and endv replay; bottom level drops the offending command.

properties.claim: A right brace seen while align_group is active is backed up, then frozen cr is inserted so v-template and cell/row completion occur before the original brace is replayed to finish the alignment.
preconditions: A physical right brace closes an alignment entry before a row-ending cr.
expected_observations: Brace delivery and backup correction precede inserted-cr delivery, v-template completion, row completion, and brace replay.
postconditions: The cell and row close exactly once and the replayed brace reaches align_peek as the alignment terminator.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: top-level/nested close; brace: empty/nonempty cell body; template: ordinary/omit; cell/row/span: single/spanned final cell; mode: halign/valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing cr emits the canonical diagnostic and immutable frozen cr; no execution group is closed by the first brace delivery.

properties.claim: Closing no_align_group ends any paragraph, unsaves exactly that group, and resumes align_peek with the surrounding alignment state intact.
preconditions: align_peek selected noalign, consumed its opening brace, and no_align_group is current.
expected_observations: Noalign material occupies the enclosing row-list orientation and group close is followed by row lookahead, not cell-template replay.
postconditions: Local noalign assignments are unsaved and the next row, repeated noalign, crcr, or alignment close is selected normally.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: nested alignment noalign; brace: grouped/no paragraph material; template: before next u; cell/row/span: between rows and repeated noalign; mode: halign/valign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing noalign opener uses scan_left_brace recovery; misplaced noalign is handled by §1129 and never creates this group.

properties.claim: A completed display halign scans following assignments, requires the closing double math shift, reports and backs up a non-math-shift command for canonical missing-double-dollar recovery, restores the enclosing nest, inserts display penalties/glue around the alignment list, restores prev_depth, and resumes after display.
preconditions: fin_align completed a halign whose enclosing mode is display math.
expected_observations: Assignments precede delimiter validation; a non-math-shift command produces `Missing $$ inserted`, is backed up by back_error, and remains available after inserted recovery; the final vertical list orders pre-penalty, above glue, alignment, post-penalty, and below glue.
postconditions: Display mode is closed, prev_depth is restored, and normal post-display scanning resumes.
equivalence_cases: Nesting: display inside enclosing vertical group; brace: alignment close before dollars; template: ordinary/omit; cell/row/span: single/multiple rows and spans; mode: display halign.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing or single closing math shift follows the canonical display-delimiter diagnostic and insertion path without duplicating the alignment list.
